units.source_text: 为了庆祝我毕业，父亲和母亲商量着要做红米饭请客。

en.t: To celebrate my graduation, my father and mother discussed making red rice and inviting guests.

units.source_text: 我从回家那天起，就暗暗担忧这个事，所以当即表示反对。

en.t: From the day I came home, I had secretly been worried about this, so I objected at once.

units.source_text: “不用太铺张了吧。”

en.t: There is no need to make it too extravagant, is there?

units.source_text: 我很讨厌那些来赴宴的乡下人。

en.t: I greatly disliked the country people who came to banquets.

units.source_text: 全都是些闲得无聊、爱凑热闹的人，来的目的无非是大吃大喝一顿。

en.t: They were all idle, bored people who loved joining in a fuss, and their only purpose in coming was to eat and drink their fill.

units.source_text: 我从小就特别发怵陪着他们吃饭，更何况他们是为我而来。

en.t: Ever since childhood I had been especially afraid of sitting at meals with them, all the more when they were coming for my sake.

units.source_text: 于是乎，请客时自己疲于应酬、痛苦不堪的场景，顿时浮现在眼前。

en.t: At once I pictured myself exhausted by social duties and suffering miserably while entertaining them.

units.source_text: 可是我又不好对父母直说别请那些粗俗的乡下人来瞎折腾，只好说別太铺张了。

en.t: But I could not tell my parents directly not to invite those coarse country people to make a pointless commotion, so I could only say that it should not be too extravagant.

units.source_text: “你总是铺张、铺张的，这算哪门子铺张啊？

en.t: You keep saying extravagant, extravagant, but how is this extravagant at all?

units.source_text: 一辈子不就这么一回吗！

en.t: Does this not happen only once in a lifetime?

units.source_text: 请客是理所当然的，你用不着这么顾虑。”

en.t: It is only natural to invite guests, so you need not worry about it so much.

units.source_text: 母亲似乎把我大学毕业看得跟娶媳妇一般重要。

en.t: Mother seemed to regard my graduation from university as being as important as taking a wife.

units.source_text: “虽说也可以不请客，但不请客的话，人家会说闲话呀！”

en.t: We could choose not to invite anyone, but if we do not, people will gossip.

units.source_text: 父亲这样说道。

en.t: Father said this.

units.source_text: 父亲担心人们说三道四，实际上那些人也确实是这样，

en.t: Father was worried that people would gossip, and in fact those people really were like that.

units.source_text: 要是这种场合遂不了他们的心愿，马上就会说闲话的。

en.t: If things did not go as they wished on such an occasion, they would immediately start talking.

units.source_text: “乡下可不比东京，讲究老理儿的。”

en.t: The countryside is not like Tokyo; people care about the old customs.

units.source_text: 父亲又说。

en.t: Father added.

units.source_text: “再说，你爸也要面子呀。”

en.t: Besides, your father has his reputation to consider too.

units.source_text: 母亲又跟着补了一句。

en.t: Mother then added another word in support.

units.source_text: 我也无法坚持己见了，

en.t: I could no longer insist on my own opinion.

units.source_text: 心想，还是依着二老，随他们便吧。

en.t: I thought it would be better to yield to my parents and let them do as they pleased.
